title: How Semiconductors Ruined East Germany
summary: Asianometry examines how East Germany tried and failed to build a native semiconductor industry despite heavy investment, including the espionage involved in acquiring Western microelectronics technology.
why: HN commenters share it in chip fab and industrial espionage threads as a well-researched account of East Germany's failed microelectronics effort.

quote.text: this is a well researched video by Asianometry, which actually contains a couple of details (unlike the Politico article) about the spycraft involved
